dialogues.speaker: Pyrrho
dialogues.text: Though Lady Sorush speaks for you, I will not be so lenient should you make any suspicious movements!

response.speaker: Pyrrho
response.text: Hmph. Of course. I am one of the oldest qualified members of our Order, after all.

response.speaker: Pyrrho
response.text: I am not quite the equal of our Vijnanapati, but as one of the desertfolk who have lived here for generations, the Order and I are as one by blood.

response.speaker: Pyrrho
response.text: So if you encounter any issues, you can ask...

response.speaker: Pyrrho
response.text: No, wait! No. I won't be answering any of your questions!

response.speaker: Pyrrho
response.text: He's a very knowledgeable scholar! He knows more than anyone I've ever met.

response.speaker: Pyrrho
response.text: We Skeptics were once a Darshan within the Akademiya, but our traditions of knowledge have been eroded after hundreds of years here in the desert, far from the city.

response.speaker: Pyrrho
response.text: It's all thanks to our Vijnanapati that we are recovering our ancient traditions. With him around, our Order shall soon reclaim our lost glory!

choices.text: Don't worry, you shan't hear questions from me.
